non_goals: infer paid demand from public launch or pricing signals
stop_loss: stop if fewer than 2 of 5 qualified workflow interviews identify repeated scene setup or correction as a material pain
stop if the structured representation cannot round-trip three canonical edit cases without manual state repair
stop if the selected dependency path cannot reach an independently reviewed commercial-use rights state

three canonical scene edits round-trip through the structured representation with deterministic validation receipts
one bounded end-to-end prototype produces a readable structured-state receipt without claiming named-product equivalence
mvp.wedge: Validate whether a structured scene specification plus deterministic constraint checks reduces repeated setup and correction before investing in a probabilistic rendering backend.

riskiest_assumptions.falsifier: Qualified users do not report repeated scene setup or correction as a meaningful recurring problem.
riskiest_assumptions.statement: A recurring user pain exists that is better addressed by persistent structured scene state than by prompt-only generation.

riskiest_assumptions.falsifier: Structured state and deterministic constraints do not reduce retries, correction time, or edit ambiguity in the owned prototype.
riskiest_assumptions.statement: The structured compiler pattern creates measurable workflow value independent of the generation model.

riskiest_assumptions.falsifier: No commercially admissible dependency set can satisfy the required workflow without unacceptable disclosure or service restrictions.
riskiest_assumptions.statement: A commercially admissible implementation path exists after exact package and transitive-rights review.
